positive_area.cover_structure: 30 inches protective soil plus minimum 6 inches topsoil over geosynthetics
positive_area.construction_measurement_support: combined cover thickness measured every 50 to 75 feet during placement; additional soil added until minimum 36 inches was achieved

possible_negative_area.confirmation_sampling: 23 samples on an approximate 50-foot grid; two failed corners were re-excavated and passed on resampling
possible_negative_area.topsoil_support: monthly report anticipated completion of topsoil placement in the former Burris yard
possible_negative_area.vegetation_support: all disturbed areas were to be seeded, fertilized and mulched

surface_comparability.reason: Both areas received soil and vegetation restoration, but the cap has a documented minimum 6-inch topsoil layer while the former yard restoration thickness and exact final assembly are not stated.

pixel_support.reason: The final negative boundary is not surveyed and the possible yard area is constrained by the access road, workshop, former house area, woods and cap edge.

fatal_blockers: No final surveyed excavation polygon or final sample-coordinate table for the restored former residential yard and driveway.
No stated horizontal datum for the recovered final survey drawings, so no defensible exact WGS84 geometry can be created from the public package alone.
No numerical survey accuracy or cover-depth measurement uncertainty is stated.
The restored negative area's topsoil thickness and exact final surface assembly are not documented as identical to the capped area.
A clean 20 m negative footprint cannot be confirmed from final as-built evidence.
